questions.question: Tap K can fill a tank in 8 hours and tap L can fill the same tank in 20 hours. In how many hours both tap K and L together can fill the same tank?
questions.solution:
**GIVEN:**

Time taken by tap K to fill the tank = 8 hours

Time taken by tap L to fill the same tank = 20 hours

**CALCULATION:**

Tank filled by tap K in 1 hour = 1/8

Tank filled by tap L in 1 hour = 1/20

Tank filled by tap K and L together in 1 hour = 1/8 + 1/20 = 7/40

∴ Time taken by tap K and L to fill the whole tank together = 40/7 hours

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a63c93e11c1bd5840d125804b189a0e6fab4be6ad12b4d33c13eace1e72ac42b.png] ** **

Let the total work be LCM of 8 and 20 = 40 unit

Tank filled by tap K in 1 hour = 40/8 = 5 unit

Tank filled by tap L in 1 hour = 40/20 = 2 unit

Tank filled by tap K and L together in 1 hour = 7 unit

∴ Time taken by tap K and L to fill the whole tank together = 40/7 hours

questions.question: Height of a right circular cone is 8 cm. If diameter of its base is 12 cm, then what will be the curved surface area of the cone?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The diameter of the base is 12 cm.

Height is 8 cm

**Formula Used:**

The curved surface area of the cone = π × r × l

Where,

r = radius,

l = slant height,

l = √(r2 + h2) ; h = height

**Calculation:**

Diameter = 12 cm,

⇒ r = D/2 = 12/2 = 6 cm

Using the above formula,

l = √(r2 + h2) 

⇒ l = √(6² + 8²) 

⇒ l = √(36 + 64) = √100 

⇒ l = 10 cm

The curved surface area of the cone,

⇒ (22/7) × 6 × 10

⇒ 1320/7

**∴ The curved surface area of the cone is 1320/7 cm²**

questions.question: Selling price of first article is Rs. 960 and cost price of second article is Rs. 960. If there is a profit of 20% on first article and loss of 20% on second article, then, what will be the total loss?
questions.solution:
GIVEN:

SP of first article = Rs. 960

CP of 2ⁿd article = Rs 960

Profit on first article = 20%

Loss on 2ⁿd article = 20%

**FORMULA USED:**

Profit% = (SP – CP)/CP × 100

Loss% = (CP – SP)/CP × 100

**CALCULATION:**

After profit of 20%, CP of first article = 960 × (100/120) = Rs. 800

After loss of 20%, SP of 2ⁿd article = 960 × (80/100) = Rs. 768

Total CP of both article = 800 + 960 = Rs. 1760

Total SP of both article = 960 + 768 = Rs. 1728

∴ Total loss = 1760 – 1728 = Rs. 3

questions.question: A motorcycle is moving at the speed of 25 km/hour and its speed is increased by 7 km/hour at the end of each hour. How much time it will take to cover a distance of 225 km?
questions.solution:
**GIVEN:**

Initial speed = 25 km/hour

Total distance = 225 km

**CALCULATION:**

Distance travelled in 1st hour ate speed of 25 km/hour = 25 km

Due to increase in speed by 7 km/hour at the end of each hour

Distance travelled in 2ⁿd hour = 25 + 7 = 32 km

Similarly, in 3rd 4th and 5th hour distance will be = 39, 46 and 53 km

So distance travelled by him till now in 5 hours = 195 km

Remaining distance = 225 – 195 = 30 km

Speed in next hour will be 53 + 7 = 60 km/hour

To travel left 30 km at speed of 60 km/hour, time taken = 30/60 = 30 minutes

∴ 225 km will be travelled in = 5 hours + 30 minute = 11/2 hours

questions.question: The ratio of the areas of two triangles is 1 : 2 and the ratio of their bases is 3 : 4. What will be the ratio of their height?
questions.solution:
**CONCEPT: **

Area of triangle = (1/2) × height × base

**CALCULATION:**

Let the bases of the two triangles are 3x and 4x respectively

Let the height of the two triangles are a and b respectively.

Ratio of areas = 1 : 2

(1/2) × a × 3x: (1/2) × b × 4x = 1 : 2

⇒ 3ax: 4bx = 1 : 2

⇒ 3ax/4bx = 1/2

⇒ a/b = 4/6

**∴ Ratio of their height, a: b = 2 : 3**

questions.question: The Least Common Multiple and Highest common Factor of two numbers are 30 and 5 respectively. If their sum is 25, then what will be the difference of these two numbers?
questions.solution:
**Concept:**

The largest common factor of two or more numbers is called the **highest common factor.**

The smallest positive number that is a multiple of two or more numbers is called **Least common multiple**

**Formula Used:**

LCM × HCF = Product of two number

**Calculation:**

Let the number be a and b

LCM × HCF = a × b

⇒ a × b = 150 ---- (1)

Given than,

⇒ a + b = 25 ----(2)

Taking square on both sides,

⇒ (a + b)² = 25²

⇒ a² + b² + 2ab = 625

⇒ a2 + b2 + 2(150) = 625

⇒ a2 + b2 = 625 – 300 = 325 ----(3)

(a – b)² = a² + b² – 2ab 

⇒ (a – b)2 = 325 – 2(150)

⇒ (a – b)2 = 325 – 300 = 25

⇒ a – b = 5 ----(4)

Adding equation (2) and (4),we get,

⇒ a + b + a – b = 25 + 5

⇒ 2a = 30

⇒ a = 30/2 = 15

Substituting a = 15, in equation (4)

⇒ a – b = 5,

⇒ 15 – b = 5

⇒ b = 15 – 5 = 10 

**∴ required difference of these two numbers = 15 – 10 = 5**

Due to difference in SP he earns Rs. 332 less

∴ Marked price = 100 unit = 83 × 100 = Rs. 8300

Cost Price of 25 article = Rs. 25

Selling price of 25 article at 25% profit = 25 × (5/4)

Cost price of remaining 75 articles = Rs. 75

⇒ Loss% = 100 – (350/4) = -12.5% where (- sign) indicates loss

questions.question: 40 mechanics can repair a bike in 56 days. In how many days 32 mechanics will do the same work?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Using the chain rule (M₁D₁ = M₂D₂):

⇒ 40 × 56 = 32 × D₂

⇒ D₂ = (40 × 56) ÷ 32

⇒ D₂ = 2240 ÷ 32 = 70

**∴ The correct answer is 70 days.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

 
 

 **Person**
 **Days**
 **Total Work**
 **Efficiency**
 
 

 40 Mechanics
 56
 2240
 40
 
 

 32 Mechanics
 ?
 32
 
 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Assuming the efficiency of 1 mechanic is 1 unit/day.

⇒ Total Work = Efficiency of 40 Mechanics × Days

⇒ Total Work = 40 × 56 = 2240 units

⇒ Days required by 32 Mechanics = Total Work ÷ Efficiency of 32 Mechanics

⇒ Days = 2240 ÷ 32

⇒ Days = 70

**∴ The correct answer is 70 days.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Chain Rule (MDH Formula)

(M₁ × D₁ × H₁) ÷ W₁ = (M₂ × D₂ × H₂) ÷ W₂, where M is Men, D is Days, H is Hours, and W is Work.

Inverse Proportion

When the amount of work is constant, the number of workers is inversely proportional to the number of days required (M × D = Constant). More mechanics will take fewer days, and fewer mechanics will take more days.
